evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Primula vulgaris Huds., Primrose
terms.comment: Hudson’s name. prīmula, “the little first one”, is the feminine of the diminutive prīmulus, which Lewis & Short has from Plautus, and takes its long ī; vulgāris is marked from Lewis & Short.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
